doc.description:
Forwards the rigid bodies of an OptiTrack motion capture system (NatNet 3) to the aircraft over Ivy, as ENU position and attitude.
The frame is set by the side of the test area that the long edge of the calibration tool pointed at (--long_edge), the side of the x/east axis (--x_side or --x_angle_from_right) and the side the nose of the drone pointed at when the rigid body was created (--ac_nose).
Examples:
ENAC default: ./natnet2ivy.py --up_axis z_up --long_edge near --x_side right --ac_nose far -ac 0 0 TU Delft: ./natnet2ivy.py --long_edge right --x_side right --ac_nose far -ac 0 0 True ENU at TU Delft: ./natnet2ivy.py --long_edge right --x_angle_from_right -23.0 --ac_nose far -ac 0 0
doc.usage: usage: natnet2ivy.py [-h] -le {left,far,right,near} (-xs {left,far,right,near} | -xa X_ANGLE) [-up {y_up,z_up}] -an {left,far,right,near} -ac rigid_id ac_id [-b IVY_BUS] [-s SERVER] [-m MULTICAST] [-dp DATA_PORT] [-cp COMMAND_PORT] [-v] [-f FREQ] [-gr] [-vs VEL_SAMPLES] [-rg] [-sm] [-o]

option.description: Side of the test area that the long edge of the calibration tool was pointing at
Side that the x/east axis of the resulting ENU frame should point to.
Right-hand rotation in degrees of the x/east-axis around the up-axis, where 0.0 means x/east is pointing to the right
Optitrack Up axis: y_up or z_up.
Side of the test area that the nose of the drone was pointing at when definition the rigid body
pair of rigid body and A/C id (multiple possible)
NatNet server data socket UDP port
NatNet server command socket UDP port
amount of samples to compute velocity (should be greater than 2)
enable the EXTERNAL_POSE_SMALL message instead of the full
no parameter is equal to y_up
